svg.title: 405 repositories in orbit
svg.desc: A rotating 3D sphere with one point for each of 405 public repositories, sized by stars and colored by section. Robinhood Chain: 22; x402 payments and agent commerce: 86; MCP servers for AI agents: 56; 3D AI agents and avatars: 60; Solana and pump.fun tooling: 24; DeFi mechanisms and Uniswap v4 hooks: 54; On-chain experiments and collectibles: 74; Developer tools and everything else: 29.
